description: T2: the naive crossing-weight bar-parity mechanism for the isospin antisymmetry is REFUTED (b_dd=−q·s is bar-mixed, not bar-odd; σ itself is not bar-even). u-u IS 𝟏-free (true). The confirmed antisymmetry is a full quadratic-Gram per-conjugate-pair-block effect; sign fixed by the u↔d isospin mirror, magnitude not derived here. Scope (a), no derived mechanism claimed.

data.verdict: NAIVE MECHANISM REFUTED (scope a); surviving structural fact + open part. TRUE: u-u is 𝟏-free while d-d,u-d carry a 𝟏-component. FALSE (the refuted hypothesis): that this 𝟏-component is bar-odd — b_dd = −q·s is bar-MIXED (q↦q⁻¹ is not fixed), and even the pure-σ u-u weight is not bar-even (σ−σ⁻¹=(q−q⁻¹)𝟏≠0). So the antisymmetry is NOT a one-line crossing-weight bar-parity count. What survives: (i) it is a full quadratic-Gram, per-conjugate-pair-block effect (A=3 exact: blocks (6,3),(5,3,1)); (ii) its SIGN is fixed by the u↔d isospin mirror (quark-content symmetry, hence antisymmetric across a mirror pair); (iii) its MAGNITUDE needs per-block Gram data and is not derived here. No derived mechanism claimed.
